slides.texte_overlay:
questions that make any
conversation go deeper

what made you smile today

it's lighter than how are you, and it gets a real answer. people love sharing small happy moments, and it sets a warm and open tone for everything after.

what are you excited about

this question lets people talk about what they love. you'll see their whole face change, and the conversation instantly gets more personal and honest.

what did you learn recently

asking this invites real stories instead of small talk, and it works even better when you have a fascinating little answer of your own ready to share first.
slides.texte_sophia:
what did you learn recently

i always have an answer ready because i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet. sharing it first makes everyone open up with their own.

slides.texte_overlay:
what would you do with a free year

dream questions let people show who they really are. their answer tells you more about their values than an hour of polite small talk and conversation ever could.

what changed your mind

asking about a moment someone changed their opinion leads to their most honest stories. it shows respect, and it makes people feel truly interesting and heard.
